free_tier.stated: No free tier. Lite CNY 40/month (about 1,200 requests per 5 hours, 9,000/week, 18,000/month); Pro CNY 200/month (6,000 per 5 hours, 45,000/week, 90,000/month).

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a subscription meters usage, not objects

retention.stated: not applicable: the vendor serves the inference; no caller-stored bytes

egress.terms: not applicable: the vendor serves the inference

tooling: OpenAI and Anthropic-compatible plan keys; Claude Code, CodeBuddy, Cline, Cursor, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Codex are named
chaining: the subscription request quota is the scarce link; the plan key is separate from prepaid/postpaid API keys and covers interactive tools only

limits.value: 1,200 to 6,000 requests per 5 hours by tier
API calls outside approved coding tools can suspend the subscription

identity_cost.detail: a Tencent Cloud account and a purchased plan; real-name verification for Chinese cloud accounts is common but not stated on this page

reliability_note: the model catalogue changes dynamically; out-of-scope API use can suspend the plan or revoke the key

evidence.proved: Lite and Pro are paid CNY 40 and CNY 200 per month
